title: fix(charts): a value axis over counts draws whole-number ticks (objectui#11681)
body:
Fixes #11681
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

A chart's value axis over a count now draws whole-number ticks. Dashboard charts over a `count` measure ("Tasks by Status", "Projects by Health", "Invoices by Month") used to read 0.5, 0.8, 1.5 or 2.3 on the value axis. This follows the route triage ruled on the card (comment 6017839148: Q1 A1, Q2 a, Q3 A):

- **Where the fact comes from.** The dataset answer states each measure column's aggregate (`AnalyticsResult.fields[].aggregate`, in `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0, producer objectstack#21995 / objectstack#22021). It is set whether or not the author gave the measure a label, unlike `builtinAggregate`.
- **`@object-ui/core`**: `buildChartSeries` copies a result field's `aggregate` onto every series it derives. With a pivoted second dimension, every group gets the one measure's aggregate. New exports: `INTEGER_AGGREGATES` (`count`, `count_distinct`) and `isIntegerAggregate`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`**: `DatasetWidget` keeps the aggregate on the series it builds itself:
  - the comparison overlay copies its primary's aggregate;
  - the transposed series of a dimensionless chart states an aggregate only when every measure shares the same one.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-charts`**:
  - `aggregate` is a renderer-internal member of the `dataKey` arm of `ChartRendererProps.schema.series`, and `normalizeSeries` reads it.
  - `plotsWholeNumbers` answers true when at least one series is bound to a value slot and every one of them plots an integer aggregate.
  - `yAxisSpecProps` (every cartesian value axis takes its props there, including the horizontal-bar number `XAxis`) adds `allowDecimals: false` only in that case, so each side of a dual-axis chart decides for itself. Any other slot gets no `allowDecimals` prop at all and renders as before.
  - The stale line address in the `normalizeSeries` docblock now cites the arm by name.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: the authoring face refuses `aggregate` on a chart series by name. `ChartDataSeriesSchema.aggregate` is a declared, unwritable member with guidance, and `ChartDataSeries.aggregate` is typed `?: never`. Without this, an author could write `aggregate: 'count'` on a currency sum and strip its decimals.

Not touched:
- `ChartImpl.tsx`, the inline bar component, only gets `data` and a `dataKey`, and nothing produces a measure fact for it.
- The radar's `PolarRadiusAxis` is unchanged on purpose: recharts 3.10.1 already defaults its `allowDecimals` to `false` (`defaultPolarRadiusAxisProps`). I measured this; a radar over a sum also drew whole ticks.
- `ObjectChart.tsx` and plugin-report's `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` pass their answer's fields to `buildChartSeries`, so they pick the member up with no edit. Both compile unchanged.
- Q3 A: `sum` / `min` / `max` over an integer field are not judged integer, because the answer does not state the source field's scale.

## Contract review: Clause-② yes

Two contract movements. Both are measured, not inferred.

1. **Export widens (`@object-ui/core`).** Export diff of `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts` (re-exported from the package entry) against base `fc211e817`: two new exports, `INTEGER_AGGREGATES` and `isIntegerAggregate`. `ChartResultField` and `ChartSeriesBinding` also gain an optional `aggregate?: string`. The spec-parity pin `dataset-result-field-spec-parity` (`DatasetResultField` extends `ChartResultField`) stays green, because the spec field carries `aggregate`.
2. **Accept set narrows (`@object-ui/types`).**
   - FROM: `ChartDataSeriesSchema` is non-strict, so `{ name: 'task_count', aggregate: 'count' }` parsed green with the key stripped. So did a `ChartSchema` node carrying it in `series[]`, while the raw node still reached the renderer.
   - TO: an `invalid_type` issue at `aggregate` (on the node, at `series.0.aggregate`), carrying the guidance text, and `ChartDataSeries.aggregate` is `?: never`.
   - Parse that flips, measured: with the zod member renamed away (the base shape), the refusal cases in `chart-series-aggregate-refusal-11681.test.ts` go red. The series parses (issues `null`) and the node parses (issues `undefined`). With it, they go green.
   - Producers: no authoring producer writes a series `aggregate` today. The internal arm is written only by `buildChartSeries` / `DatasetWidget`, which never meet the authoring mirror.

The changeset declares `minor` for core and types and `patch` for the two plugins.

## Tests

- New pins:
  - `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.integerMeasureTicks-11681.test.tsx`: real DOM ticks. Bar, line and area over a count; count_distinct; horizontal-bar's value axis; and a dual axis with counts on the left and a currency sum on the right. Controls: a sum keeps decimals on bar and horizontal-bar; no aggregate keeps the measured fractional ticks; a sum beside a count on one axis keeps the default.
  - `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.integerMeasureTicks-11681.test.tsx`: the full chain, from DatasetWidget through SchemaRenderer to the registered chart, with real recharts ticks. "Tasks by Status" as bar, line, area and horizontal-bar; a dimensionless chart of two counts; the comparison overlay. Controls: a sum over currency (`currency: 'USD'`) keeps its decimals; a column without an aggregate; a dimensionless count beside a sum.
  - `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.aggregate-11681.test.ts` and `packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-series-aggregate-refusal-11681.test.ts`.
- **Ablation (done once, then restored):**
  - `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) deleted the `allowDecimals` spread in `yAxisSpecProps` (anchor 1 to 0 hits, blob `1281a215f666` to `565d0292ce6b`). Then: 12 failed, 7 passed out of 19. Every integer case went red, and every control stayed green.
  - The restore was verified: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The suites resolve `@object-ui/plugin-charts` / `@object-ui/core` through the vitest source alias, so no `dist` preflight applies.
  - A second one-off mutation renamed the zod member away; it gave the Clause-② parse flip above (4 red, then restored).
- Full test projects of all four packages at merged head `d62511d7b` (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/core/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/plugin-dashboard/`, under the verify lock): `Test Files 851 passed (851)`, `Tests 17328 passed | 42 skipped`.

## Gates (at `d62511d7b` unless noted)

- Closure build, then `type-check` for types, core, plugin-charts and plugin-dashboard (each one compiles its tests): exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 11 changed TS files (the count comes from the JSON output): 0 errors. This narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware, and an edit cannot change the verdict on a file it did not touch. The full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- Pre-tsc battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes` and `new-line-citations` all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 ("The scan collapsed"). That is the known main-side failure tracked at objectui#12334, recorded and not fixed here.
- `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `PolarRadiusAxis` (radar) needed no change; see above.
- A dimensionless chart mixing `count` and `count_distinct` states no single aggregate, so it keeps the default ticks. That is the conservative direction: non-integer is never asserted.

The implementing session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`.
